nom: Bubble Cosmic Silk Hydrating Milky Toner

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-combination skin report the toner pairs well under moisturizer and gives glow without excess oil.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe strong hydration, softer skin, and improvement of dry patches, with one calling it a holy grail.
segments.combination: A reviewer with oily-combination and rosacea-prone skin reports hydration and glow without new breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report good tolerance and hydration without irritation or redness, though one sensitive-skin reviewer had a severe breakout.
segments.normal: One reviewer notes the toner suits any skin type and is a cheap, effective option without specifying issues.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature (38+, 55+) skin report visible plumping, glow, and softened fine lines with regular use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers over 38 and over 55 report the toner leaves skin looking younger, glowing, and helps soften fine lines with daily use.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, across skin types, report strong, quick hydration, softness, and relief of dryness or dry patches.
concerns.redness: One reviewer specifically notes it does not increase facial redness; another with rosacea-prone skin reports no flare-ups.
concerns.barrier: An eczema-prone reviewer reports the product works well for their skin despite the packaging issues; sensitive-skin reviewers generally report no irritation.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers with acne-prone skin report no new breakouts and even improved clarity, but one reviewer with sensitive skin describes a severe cystic-acne breakout after two days of use.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone or breakout-prone reviewers report clearer skin and no pimples, but a minority report small breakouts unless usage amount is reduced.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin reports the toner feels balanced under moisturizer without adding oiliness; another notes it is hydrating without feeling greasy.

aspects.libelle: Packaging squirts or leaks on closing

extraits.titre: Don't fall for the positive reviews
extraits.texte: I wish i had read more indepth on this product and not been influenced by their paid partners on social media because i thought hey why not? Seems like a nice product and my skin is dry. Huge, huge HUGE MISTAKE. It worked lovely for about two days then gave me the nastiest break out ive ever had in my LIFE. I have sensitive skin and saw people raving and thought to take a chance and try something new. I wish i never did. I wish i could post the pictures in this review of my skin. I'd get a pimple or two along my forhead or chin every so often but not nearly my entire face in what looks like cystic acne. It hurts and im extremly self concious about it…. All this mess from this one product..

Holy wow- i went back and forth between thayers, bubble, ans byoma. I chose this one because i have reallly dry skin and honestly this has made more of a difference than any product ive ever tried. My skin drinks this stuff up and has felt amazing. New holy grail!!!

this is the best milky toner I have ever tried that leaves my skin glowing all day and it looks so much younger I am hooked and the fact that it's cruelty free and vegan is a plus I have over 55 skin and it works amazing!

So i struggled with acne prone sensitive skin. I also have a little bit of rosacea in my cheek area and oily combination skin. I have been struggling to finally get clear glowy skin and this product is one of my go tos now in my routine! No breaks out ever and it hydrats my skin so well leaving such a great glow also under makeup it is game changer. I recommend this to everyone it is wonderful 🩷

I am 38 and this toner has done wonders for my skin. Really hydrates the skin and is a must in my skin prep prior to makeup. The way this has made a difference in my fine lines due to its hydration has me reaching for this once if not twice a day. I will be repurchasing.

I have never used toner because I have very sensitive skin so, I was worried trying this out. Its so hydrating and has transformed my skin!! My skin has never looked better, its so smooth and glowing. Def buying again 🫶🏼

Toner is SO hydrating and has a really pleasant texture, but the packaging is as bad as everyone says. It's hard to control how much product comes out and it drips all over the top of the packaging. It feels wasteful because so much comes out I usually have to wipe on my arms or wash off. I'm only tempted to rebuy because the product itself is actually really great for my eczema-prone skin...
